## What is LifeWise?

LifeWise is a Family Operating System (Family OS): one mobile app that lets a family manage every member's health, finances, reminders, documents, and daily routines from one place. Official site: [lifewiseee.com](https://www.lifewiseee.com). Google Play package: `com.lifewise`.

## Disambiguation

LifeWise at [lifewiseee.com](https://www.lifewiseee.com) / [com.lifewise](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lifewise) is **not** LifeWise Student Insurance or LifeWise Assurance Company.
